allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: HLE Glascoat Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Listing of shares allotted pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: HLE Glascoat Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on September 27, 2025 and it is informed that the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today on September 27, 2025, has allotted 11,89,259 fully-paid up equity shares of Rs.2, to the eligible shareholders of the Transferor Company (other than the Transferee Company whose shares are cancelled) who were holding shares as on the Effective Date, in compliance with the Clause 8 of the Scheme..
